status: development plan; freeze and verify before any full-run model call
evidence: Original mavra-push reaches its own old-program validation target at the first clean validation in23/24 reuse sessions. Refine Stack completed15/15 clean sessions with all six cost columns preserved, but zero quality metrics first; only16 of a possible48 warm model responses were used. The typed-entity component passed its preregistered gate on4/6 first-cutoff validation tasks, with all6 native audits clean. Existing candidate tests have been inspected: development is post-hoc, not an independent holdout.
hypothesis: A compact checked feature inventory and a small added-feature SQL are cheaper and more useful refinement targets than rewriting or immediately submitting a whole inherited program. Preserve the complete audited incumbent and evaluate complementary additions using its current-cutoff cached matrices.
cold: Keep two independent own-task searches with the original learner, sample, validation budget and40-response cap. Within measured method work, compute and audit numeric/date and schema-typed entity views and choose on validation only; retain the numeric/date control and constant fallback semantics. Do not change the framework common reference, its tests or fallback scores.
reuse: Keep the4-response/6-agent-tool ceilings. When a checked base is available, expose a validate-additions action with at most12 new feature columns; join/deduplicate against complete current train/validation frames, enforce100 final columns, count every query/fit/failure, and reproduce the combined SQL values plus a fresh full future-row audit. Preserve the incumbent unless a clean candidate improves validation. Give a validation attempt priority over immediate submit; retain fallback when budgets or audits prevent an improvement.
prompt: Expose checked column names and training gains with a handle to the complete base. Prefer small complementary queries over copying the whole base SQL. Do not expose labels, test scores or another arm's programs. Failed/unknown audits still reject.
execution_optimization: An optional conservative grouped-CTE inlining helper may be included only after a separately recorded, successful execution component. The first attempt made no rewrite because the allowlist excluded a parsed date-extraction function; it is retained as an ineligible comparison, not speedup evidence. No running source will be hotpatched.
controls: One global frozen configuration across both databases, original run1 order and cutoffs, model-service settings, LightGBM parameters,50k sample, price card and scoring. No task-name recipes, taskwise test-winner splicing, relaxed audits, shortened cohorts, free preflight or learner changes.
acceptance: Same complete15/15 valid sessions per database, all twelve unrounded reuse costs <= original mavra-push and all six mean test qualities >= the strongest reported arm. All cold work and all-cutoff costs also retained. Only a complete joint pass can replace paper numbers.
execution: At most4 compute cells; reuse existing tested backend bytes; start from empty independent memory. Keep the currently announced25CNY study-spend protection until a separately recorded pre-call execution amendment, if one is justified. No new full run starts before meaningful checks pass and sources are frozen.
limitations: Implementation and component gains are not full benchmark-quality evidence. A first rank in one run cannot establish a general or statistically significant guarantee.
